facts.statement: The type specimen of Meroktenos was discovered in 1959 by François Ellenberger, Paul Ellenberger, Jean Fabre, and Leonard Ginsburg south of the village of Thabana Morena.
facts.quote: In 1959, François Ellenberger, Paul Ellenberger, Jean Fabre and Leonard Ginsburg discovered the type specimen, a thighbone or femur and other assorted bones, south of the village of Thabana Morena.

facts.statement: Meroktenos was established as a separate genus in 2016 by Claire Peyre de Fabrègues and Ronan Allain.
facts.quote: In 2016, M. thabanensis was appointed to the separate genus Meroktenos by Claire Peyre de Fabrègues and Ronan Allain.

facts.statement: The femur of Meroktenos is very compact with a robusticity index of 2.09.
facts.quote: The femur is very compact with a robusticity index, length divided by the circumference of the shaft, of 2.09.

facts.statement: Meroktenos possesses a remarkably high relative transverse width of the femur for an animal of its small size.
facts.quote: The relative transverse width of the femur, the eccentricity, is remarkably high for such a small animal.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that the unusual femoral proportions of Meroktenos must have served a function different from supporting giant body weight, as the animal was likely not a giant.
facts.quote: Because the holotype probably was not a young animal and is unlikely to have attained giant proportions, the trait must have had a different function.

facts.statement: Meroktenos lived during the Late Triassic period in what is now Lesotho.
facts.quote: Meroktenos is a genus of basal sauropodomorph dinosaur that lived during the Late Triassic period of what is now Lesotho.

facts.statement: Meroktenos thabanensis lived during the Late Triassic, approximately 216 to 201 million years ago, in what is now Africa.
facts.quote: Meroktenos thabanensis es la única especie conocida del género extinto Meroktenos de dinosaurio saurisquio sauropodomorfo que vivió a finales del período Triásico, hace aproximadamente 216 a 201millones de años durante el Noriense y el Rhaetiense, en lo que ahora es África.

facts.statement: Meroktenos lived from the Norian to the Rhaetian stages, between 227.3 and 201.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Norian to Rhaetian (227.3 to 201.4 million years ago)

facts.statement: In 2016, Meroktenos was classified within the Sauropodomorpha at a basal position.
facts.quote: In 2016, Meroktenos was placed in the Sauropodomorpha, in a basal position.

facts.statement: Meroktenos is situated in the Sauropodomorpha in a basal position.
facts.quote: En 2016, Meroktenos fue situado en Sauropodomorpha, en una posición basal.

facts.statement: Cladistic analysis places Meroktenos in a polytomy with Blikanasaurus and more derived taxa, above Aardonyx and below a polytomy including Melanorosaurus and Antetonitrus.
facts.quote: De acuerdo con un análisis cladístico, Meroktenos forma una politomía con Blikanasaurus y las especies más derivadas, por sobre Aardonyx en el árbol evolutivo y por debajo una politomía que incluye a Melanorosaurus y a Antetonitrus.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen MNHN.F.LES 16 consists of a right femur, part of the right ilium, a vertebral neural arch, a left pubic bone, and a second right metatarsal.
facts.quote: The holotype, MNHN.F.LES 16, consists of a right thighbone (MNHN.F.LES16c), a portion of the right ilium, with a piece of a vertebral neural arch (MNHN.F.LES16a); a left pubic bone (MNHN.F.LES16b); and a second right metatarsal (MNHN.F.LES16d) associated with the skeleton.

facts.statement: Meroktenos is classified as an animal in the phylum Chordata, class Sauropsida, order Saurischia, and suborder Sauropodomorpha.
facts.quote: regnum: Animalia phylum: Chordata classis: Sauropsida superordo: Dinosauria ordo: Saurischia subordo: Sauropodomorpha genus: Meroktenos

facts.statement: The genus name Meroktenos combines the ancient Greek words for "thigh" and "beast".
facts.quote: The genus name is a combination of ancient Greek μηρός, meros ("thigh") and κτῆνος, ktènos ("beast").
